blindSourceSummaries: An international human-rights organisation's news release (29 October 2025): a leaked draft omnibus reform package would amend the penal and civil codes with new anti-LGBT articles: criminalising behaviour "contrary to biological sex and general morality" including its so-called "promotion", raising the minimum age for gender-affirming healthcare to 25 with onerous eligibility conditions, and enabling criminal charges against trans people and the medical professionals who treat them. The organisation called for immediate withdrawal of the package.

A national LGBT+ rights organisation's human-rights report 2025 (published February 2026): in 2025 anti-LGBT policies became institutionalised — instructions to public institutions under a family-values-year banner plus religious and administrative rhetoric from senior officials created a climate that encouraged human-rights violations. Monitoring based on media-documented violations and civil-society applications.
